gen-gf-lugrasimo-montserrat: Loose, hand-drawn lines give Lugrasimo a friendly wobble. Montserrat's sans-serif body glides underneath with generous openings and no stroke contrast, so the hand-made top feels grounded.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-satoshi: Satoshi stands tall, with a high lowercase and an open e drawn at one width throughout. Lugrasimo, by contrast, sits lower and carries a slight stamp-like thick-thin play, which gives the handwritten headings room to feel inviting above it.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-switzer: Lugrasimo's hand-drawn, loosely spaced line has stems just slightly thicker than its joins, a gentle touch of pen pressure. Switzer's sans-serif body runs steady and tall.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-work-sans: Work Sans sets its lowercase high, with joins as thick as its strokes, like spaghetti spelled out in letters. And Lugrasimo sits lower with a worn-stamp thick-thin touch, so the heading feels hand-stamped above it.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-archivo: Archivo has a commanding x-height, and its plain sans curves open outward rather than curling back in on themselves. Lumanosimo handles the casual, drawn-out headline moments; Archivo does the steady work below.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk draws every letter with no thick-and-thin modulation at all, which keeps its sans text crisp and approachable. And Lumanosimo's wire-like handwriting above it makes extended reading feel light, never stiff.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-asap: Asap's sans body sits nearly as tall as its capitals, and its c forms read as open arcs. Lumanosimo's one-tip simplicity above it keeps a long page feeling casual.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-bespoke-serif: Lumanosimo's strokes look pulled like solder through a nozzle, casual and graceful, over Bespoke Serif's dignified classic serif. Its medium-low contrast stays dependable.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-epilogue: Curvy and unclamped, with stubby ascender tips. Epilogue's sans-serif lowercase stands tall on a wire-like skeleton, while Lumanosimo, lower and handwritten, earns its place when the heading is big and short.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-erode: Erode keeps a tall middle band with shallow ascenders and descenders, plus a broad aperture on the g and a. Lumanosimo, traced at one stylus width, looks best when sized generously.
